summary: Verified fix for user-reported invisible contact form. Replaced Reveal (whileInView) with motion.div (animate-on-mount) on form + agent block. On 1440x611 short viewport and 390x844 mobile, all form fields (contact-form, contact-name, contact-phone, contact-email, contact-interest, contact-consent, contact-submit) render with computed opacity:1, transform:none, no whileInView-gated ancestors. Agent block (James Green / Global Real Estate Advisor / eXp Realty / Equal Housing) also opacity:1 after mount. End-to-end form submit succeeded with success toast and doc persisted in connect_inquiries (interests=['Buying']) — cleaned up post-test. Home regression: popup opens ~6s, closes via popup-close; all CTAs (meet-james-cta, buy-section-cta, sell-section-cta, explore-panel-connect, nav-link-contact) present and nav-link-contact routes to /contact. No horizontal overflow on mobile (docWidth==winWidth==390).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct and minimal: only the form + agent motion.div wrappers were switched from whileInView Reveal to animate-on-mount; the top intro Reveal was intentionally kept and works fine because it's above the fold on load. No side effects observed.
Two console warnings on home ('container non-static position ... scroll offset') come from framer-motion useScroll on a static ancestor — cosmetic, non-blocking, unchanged from iteration_1.

Minor: on 1440x611 the form's first input sits at y≈491 (fold at 611), so ~120px is above fold and the rest is one short scroll away — expected for a 611px browser; NOT the reported bug. The bug was opacity:0 which is now resolved.
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST doc inserted via UI submit at email=test_bug@example.com, deleted after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified. ContactPage form + agent block now use motion.div animate-on-mount (not whileInView) — never gated by IntersectionObserver. If regression re-appears, check ContactPage.js lines 73-77 and 177-180 were not reverted to <Reveal>. Popup delay is ~6s on home; wait 7s then click popup-close.
rca of the issue: Original bug: form was wrapped in <Reveal> which uses framer-motion whileInView + IntersectionObserver, starting at opacity:0. In some browsers/short viewports/reduced-motion settings the IO trigger never fired, leaving the form permanently invisible. Fix (verified): swap the wrapping <Reveal> around <form> and the bottom agent block for a plain motion.div with initial={opacity:0,y:30} + animate={opacity:1,y:0} — plays unconditionally on mount, no scroll dependency. Confirmed computed opacity:1 / transform:none on all target testids at both 1440x611 and 390x844.
